title: Leonard Susskind on The World As Hologram | TVO Docs
summary: Stanford physicist Leonard Susskind gives a public lecture on the holographic principle, the indestructibility of information and the nature of black holes. It asks whether the world could be a hologram.
why: HN commenters recommend it as an accessible yet substantive introduction to the holographic principle and black hole information, often when related physics news comes up.

quote.text: IIRC these are very good videos to start with
